name: Empty site shows clear empty states and filters still work
description: Verifies a fresh site with no uploads explains that nothing has been posted yet and that the browse filters still respond.
steps: Open the home page
Click the 'LoRA' category chip
Click the '#스타일' tag chip
Click '다운로드순' and then '주간'
Open the '이미지' page from the header navigation
expected: Before filtering the home page shows '아직 올라온 모델이 없어요' with a '모델 업로드' button; after filtering it shows '조건에 맞는 모델이 없어요'; the 이미지 page shows '아직 올라온 이미지가 없어요'.

name: Browse the empty site on mobile
description: Verifies the model and image pages fit a phone-sized screen when nothing has been posted yet.
steps: Open the home page
Open the '이미지' page from the header navigation
Open the '모델' page from the header navigation
expected: Each page shows its empty message ('아직 올라온 모델이 없어요' or '아직 올라온 이미지가 없어요') or cards, and none of the pages scrolls horizontally.

name: Block uploads for signed-out visitors
description: Verifies that a visitor who is not signed in cannot reach the upload form.
steps: Without signing in, open the URL path '#/models/new'
Open the URL path '#/images/new'
expected: Both pages show a '로그인이 필요해요' card with a '로그인' button and no upload form fields are shown.

name: Upload a model, view and like it, then delete it
covers: model detail rendering of uploaded content
description: Verifies a signed-in user can publish a model with an uploaded sample image, like it, and remove it again so the site is left empty.
steps: Sign in
Open '만들기' in the header and choose '모델 업로드'
Click '모델 올리기' without filling anything in
Enter the model name 'QA 테스트 LoRA', choose the 'LoRA' type and the 'SDXL' base model
In the 모델 파일 section enter the external link 'https://huggingface.co/test/qa-model'
Add one PNG or JPEG image as a sample image
Click '모델 올리기'
On the new model page click the uploaded sample image, then close the dialog
Click the heart like button next to the model title, then refresh the page
Click '삭제' and confirm the dialog
Refresh the home page
expected: The empty submit shows the error '모델 이름을 2자 이상 입력해 주세요.'; after the real submit the model page shows 'QA 테스트 LoRA' with the uploaded image; clicking the image opens a dialog showing it large; after liking and refreshing, the like button is still highlighted with the count 1; after deleting and refreshing, 'QA 테스트 LoRA' is no longer listed on the home page.

name: Reject an image post without an image
description: Verifies the image posting form blocks a submission that has no image attached.
steps: Sign in
Open the URL path '#/images/new'
Click '이미지 게시하기' without adding an image
expected: The form shows the error '이미지를 1장 이상 선택해 주세요.' and stays on the upload page.
